description: Domain knowledge for a crypto analysis: the constraints of the topic, the Basis tool chain, and — the part worth calling for — findings Basis has actually measured, each with its sample and verdict, plus the conventional readings it has NOT measured, marked as such. Call it before analysing a chart pattern, interpreting an indicator level, designing a strategy or judging a result that looks strong. It carries no live market data.
name: crypto_quant_guide
